name: Olyss
summary: Olyss features a layered board wrapped in dark grey matte elm veneer, giving the surface a smooth, contemporary richness. The central column is finished in brass metallic, adding a warm, polished accent that lifts the entire silhouette. The contrast between the muted wood tone and the luminous brass gives the piece a refined, sculptural presence. The layer board cover with elm veneer in dark grey matt, the column paint in brass metallic. 120×42.5×191
